mentions.description: A compiler targeting linux/amd64 for a simple scripting language, built as a learning/fun project rather than a serious language effort.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a linux/amd64 compiler for a simple scripting language, it barely seems worth discussing as many people have created their own languages, and it's done just for learning/fun rather than in an attempt to be serious.
